first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: A person with long reddish-brown hair hanging down the back, wearing layered dark reddish-brown clothing and armor and dark boots, and carrying a long weapon on the back.

entities.name: Robot A
entities.identification: A flying robot composed of a black mechanical body, broad segmented wing surfaces, orange components, a blue glowing head and neck, and mechanical legs.

entities.name: light-colored branching dirt path
entities.identification: A dirt-and-stone passage through the woodland, wider at the near end, including a light brown road section and a reddish-brown branch on the right.

entities.name: woodland with green vegetation and red shrubs
entities.identification: A collection of low green leafy growth, bands of red shrubs, and tall, slender-trunked trees on both sides of the road and between its branches.

entities.name: moss-covered rock outcrop
entities.identification: A dark-green-covered rocky hill on the right and light gray rock outcrops among the vegetation in the distance.

entities.name: blue sky and white clouds
entities.identification: The pale blue sky and white and grayish-white cloud masses in the upper part of the image.

entities.name: bow-shaped long weapon carried on the back
entities.identification: A dark long weapon positioned diagonally behind Person A, with a lighter-colored curved end protruding beyond the shoulder.

entities.name: white mist among the trees
entities.identification: A translucent milky-white layer of mist among the trees in the middle distance and background.

entities.name: slanting light through the trees
entities.identification: A pale white diagonal band of light with soft edges in the mist layer among the trees.

entities.name: bottom-left status icon
entities.identification: A UI overlay in the bottom-left corner composed of white numbers, outline icons, and a green cross.

entities.name: orange-red lens flare
entities.identification: An orange vertical bright band at the right edge, a translucent red light patch in the middle, and a horizontal orange light band at the top.
